stimulus_db:
Wong: Although all countries are better off as democracies, a transitional autocratic stage is sometimes required before a country can become democratic.

Tate: The freedom and autonomy that democracy provides are of genuine value, but the simple material needs of people are more important. Some countries can better meet these needs as autocracies than as democracies.
stem_db: Wong's and Tate's statements provide the most support for the claim that they disagree over the truth of which one of the following?

choices_db.A: There are some countries that are better off as autocracies than as democracies.
choices_db.B: Nothing is more important to a country than the freedom and autonomy of the individuals who live in that country.
choices_db.C: In some cases, a country cannot become a democracy.
choices_db.D: The freedom and autonomy that democracy provides are of genuine value.
choices_db.E: All democracies succeed in meeting the simple material needs of people.

steps.label: Wong / Tate
steps.body:
Wong:
All countries are better off as democracies.
A transitional autocratic stage is sometimes required before a country can become democratic.

Tate:
The freedom and autonomy that democracy provides are of genuine value, but the simple material needs of people are more important.
Some countries can better meet these needs as autocracies than as democracies.

steps.label: Evaluate
steps.body: Wong and Tate disagree about whether all countries are better off as democracies. Wong says they all are. Tate says some countries are better off as autocracies.
